criteria.text: Every panel claim is labeled grounded (cited to the context package) or assumption/hypothesis/recall; no recall presented as evidence.
Final arbiter recommendation covers: logic review of (a)-(d), developer-visible UI/config in OpenIDEA + CLI, and adoption guidance, with ranked options and disclosed uncertainty.
Non-coding boundary respected: no files edited, no builds/tests run, workflow state only via open_ultracode record tools.
Final response discloses strategy, panel agents, decider source, visible model identifiers, round summaries, degraded states, warnings, and decision source.

New .kiro/steering/agent-guidance.md pins (c) as CLI/harness feedback loop (kiro-cli JSON findings + BDD witnesses; vocabulary.toml/spec.json topics as prompt pre-commitments; annotation grammar in steering templates) and explicitly rules out ungrounded NVIDIA formal-methods integration.
spec-constraints amended with CHECK_COVERAGE info finding (annotation coverage counts) and documented same-topic-only limitation.
plugin-core amended with the three-tier output contract and a clipped-notification trailer naming the .insert variant when one exists.

vocabulary-grounding amended with a cross-topic label-collision info finding; spec-visualization notes text-table as primary notification form; spec-navigation refuses comment-syntax insert on unrecognized file types.
roadmap.md records sequencing ((a)+(b)+nav before viz) and the deferred 4C/GoF/naming items with vocabulary-topics as the future hook.
No Rust code touched, no builds run; edits verified by re-reading the changed sections.
All 10 cross-spec checks from kiro-spec-batch Step 4 are explicitly evaluated against the current specs and steering.
Round-1 fixes (issues 1-6, 9, 10, 11) are confirmed present in the files; issues 7, 8, 12 have an explicit disposition (still open / fixed / accepted).

The 2026-11-04 amendments are checked for internal consistency: finding codes registered everywhere they are referenced, requirement numbering unique, task _Boundary:_ components exist in the corresponding design, cross-references valid.
Effort-reduction output is a ranked list of adoptable libs/approaches, each with constraint-compliance analysis and evidence labels, plus a shortlist of 'adopt now' vs 'keep hand-rolled' decisions.
Review is read-only: no files modified, no builds run.
Both panels answer from a bounded context package built from the repo; claims labeled grounded/assumption/hypothesis/recall.
Task review covers all 7 specs' tasks.md: structure, boundaries, requirement refs, depends, observables, cross-spec touches, conflicts, implementability.
Gap analysis covers per-spec req→design→tasks traceability, steering/roadmap consistency, amendment coverage, and open issues 7/8/12 with dispositions.
Non-coding boundary respected: no edits, no builds, no project state change except open_ultracode records.
Final response discloses strategy, panels, decider, model identifiers, round summaries, degraded states, warnings, decision source, confidence, smallest next evidence.

assumptions: 'what the specs so' = what the specs say (typo) — scope is the 7 specs under .kiro/specs plus .kiro/steering.
